answer: Initial sequence numbers carry entropy from the OS random generator, forming a per-device signal. ISN entropy is measured on connection, and the analysis runs each epoch. The quill signal separates the two cases at a glance: A farm needs 566 distinct ISN patterns, since one generator cannot produce 566 independent sequences. The beacon ledger records each payment, the raven window resets the board, and 566 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
